name: Jotham
summary: A son of Uzziah who judged the people while his father was a leper, then reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did right in the LORD's sight and grew mighty.

key_moments.title: Ruling for His Father
key_moments.description: When the LORD struck King Uzziah with leprosy, he had to live in a separate house. His son Jotham was put over the palace and judged the people.

key_moments.title: He Builds the High Gate
key_moments.description: Jotham became king at twenty-five and did right, as his father had. People still sacrificed on the high places, but he built the upper gate of the LORD's house.

key_moments.title: Mighty Before the LORD
key_moments.description: Jotham built cities and towers and beat the Ammonites, who paid him silver, wheat and barley for three years. He grew mighty because he lived rightly before his God.
